text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a profit; decisions should reflect its risk and my portfolio plan, not my cost basis.","A few periods of price movement do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term losses or gains as if they were signals.","Even when I trade infrequently, I should review diversification and risk periodically; holding steady is not a substitute for checking that the portfolio still fits my goals."]}
